correctness.rationale: For each of 32 orientations the verifier independently builds both edge-direction transitions on all 32 vertex subsets; exhaustive product BFS gives 23 accepting reachable tuples and a reachable rejecting sink. Iterated Myhill-Nerode refinement yields 18 reachable, pairwise inequivalent states with the printed canonical transition table. The transfer matrix has determinant degree at most 18 and adjugate numerator degree at most 17. Verification of coefficients 0 through 26 of QF-P forces a polynomial numerator of degree at most 26 to vanish identically. This proves the full infinite language and generating function, not just the 8191 directly checked words.

value.rationale: The five-cycle is the first graph after the triangle in the natural odd-cycle family and its remanent language has a natural exact state-complexity and growth question. The 18-state minimized infinite-language description, full rational enumerator and explicit word separating triangle from pentagon yield an interpretable graph-language invariant not determined by chromatic number. The result provides a complete benchmark, not a purported general cycle classification.
